mode: Read-only saved-run, source and existing-test design review

observed_facts.interpretation: Commit was conditional readiness, not a promise against future Heartbeat. The first safe cancellation after a single PARAM request prevented Release, and the original Ground500-ms wait subsequently expired. The Vehicle first fault detail20 is the later cleanup-boundary refusal, not Fatal128 detail13.
observed_facts.not_proven: No local firmware time comparison is treated as a PC/MCU or Vehicle/Ground clock synchronization claim. The true instantaneous physical AUX or RF waveform at Abort is not inferred.

deadline_meanings.hold750: Maximum lifetime of a single real generated but unwritten Grant reservation, starting at on_prepared. The bridge chooses min(now+750, an available Heartbeat deadline); core requires deadline>now and deadline-now<=750. It is not a guarantee of enough host-handshake time and cannot be refreshed on repeated observations.
deadline_meanings.reserve5050: Conservative full standard Grant-return occupancy: service-floor550 + uplink-guard650 + vehicle-receive-timeout2000 + late-terminal1300 + final-service-floor550. This is not the750 hold and not the500 fresh-Grant timer.
deadline_meanings.heartbeat_conflict: 5050 exceeds the fixed2500 Heartbeat deadline. Therefore any newly available valid Heartbeat with deadline at now+2500 is immediately urgent under the existing condition; even a fresh Heartbeat can trigger safe cancellation. When no selected Heartbeat tail is available the urgency predicate is inactive.
deadline_meanings.actual_margin: Prepared40579 to cancellation41029 is450ms. Cancellation occurred with300ms still left on the750 hold. This is a real phase conflict, not hold expiry. Abort41480 was451ms after cancellation, consistent with a still-active minimum550-ms normal writer, but not a physical waveform proof.

scoped_abort_option_B.judgment: Semantically sound if AbortAck means no further authority for this exact old tuple, rather than global radio idle or proof of zero historical RF traffic.
required_old_authority_proof: Identity checks first: same role, reader session, nonce, boot, current USB epoch, Grant session/cycle, token and generation
Core cancellation tombstone establishes the exact retired tuple and safe cancellation pending state
Reserved Grant UART accepted flag is false and releasing is false
Real TDD cycle was retired by cancel_unsent_grant and exact old writer lease was released as zero-accepted
The retained old tuple cannot be recreated by delayed Release, duplicate Abort, old Commit or new Grant
scoped_abort_option_B.stop128_caution: STOP128 contains token/generation and retirement predicates but no nonce, Grant session or cycle. Its first-wins retirement bits alone are insufficient to authorize cleanup of a later tuple. Bind them to the current core's exact cancellation tombstone rather than treating them as a reusable permission.
unrelated_writer_proof: An active writer must be a known, validated StandardTdd action with an arbiter lease matching the standard lease
Its token and writer generation must be new and distinct from the retired old tuple; merely comparing one token is insufficient
Do not admit any SendGrant, old Grant release, high-speed owner, profile transition, negotiation prefix, E220/arbiter fault, epoch change, or unknown writer purpose

If the exception is specified as Heartbeat-only, SendRadioData alone does not identify Heartbeat: ordinary telemetry shares the type. Bind actual selected Heartbeat producer identity to the writer token/generation or retain the narrow scope another provable way
scoped_abort_option_B.non_interference: A cleanup-only terminal Abort must not call cancel, release, clear, complete_action, reset or replay on the unrelated current writer. It tombstones only the old reservation, keeps normal Heartbeat progress intact, and queues one AbortAck using the existing checked USB publication path.
global_guards_to_retain: No high-speed radio session or constructed owner
No active profile switch or high-speed/final/peer-receipt prefix authority
No arbiter failure or explicit restore requirement
No old reserved Grant write accepted, retained prefix or release in progress
scoped_abort_option_B.legacy_unsafe_busy_tests: Must remain rejecting. A bare radio_busy=true or tail_pending=true fixture without exact old retirement and a validated distinct writer must not become an accepted Abort boundary.
scoped_abort_option_B.ACK_proof_limit: No oscilloscope or RF receipt claim is required for this local revocation ACK. Conversely, a successful local AbortAck does not prove physical RF delivery, whole-radio idleness or application-level completion.

safe_direction: Keep clock/Hello and stable prerequisites before the critical held-slot period; use the actual observed Heartbeat/TDD state when selecting the real generated Grant

Before publishing Prepared, defer an unsuitable unwritten generated Grant by retiring its exact cycle/action, retaining the original AwaitVehicleGrant preparation origin and allowing normal Heartbeat service
Only publish a new Prepared for a genuinely new cycle/token/generation with a newly bounded <=750-ms hold; record defer separately from a published-slot cancellation
Shorten runner polling/control scheduling latency within the existing bounded pump, while draining all published fault/Withdrawn evidence before every OUT and before PARAM
Treat withdrawal before PARAM as cancellation/fresh-nonce exchange only within the original budgets; after PARAM1, use terminal abort only and prohibit automatic re-prepare/reissue
reservation_admission_improvement.timing_limit: An external new Heartbeat is not predictable with a safety guarantee. Reducing handshake latency or choosing phase can reduce the observed race, but neither a750-ms hold nor Commit can guarantee a future safe release. Under a near1-Hz producer and550-ms radio service floor, observed available phase headroom can be roughly450ms; this must be measured and must not be advertised as guaranteed slack.

existing_retirement_interface.requirements: Matching pending SendGrant, SendUlGrant state, not sent, monotonic time, exact nonzero token/session/cycle, no cycle wrap
existing_retirement_interface.effect: Clear pending action, increment cycle, increment action_retries, reopen normal selected Heartbeat tail
existing_retirement_interface.bridge_lease: release_rejected_standard_radio_writer_lease(now) verifies exact standard lease and no pending tail, completes UART as Rejected, requires RejectedReleased, then clears that exact standard lease

prepublication_cautions: begin_cancel requires an existing published holding state and consumes the one-cancellation budget; it is not a suitable substitute for a pre-Prepared scheduling defer
Do not reset begin-prepare/original preparation clocks to make repeated defers appear fresh
Do not use generic complete_action(Rejected) to obtain a new token for the same old cycle
If TDD retirement succeeds and lease release fails, fail closed; do not publish a new slot or pretend cancellation completed
Defer must be bounded by the original MCU8s/PC15s preparation and require new cycle/generation, not create an unlimited replay loop
prohibited_shortcuts: Restart Ground t0 or the500-ms timer
Treat stale baseline Grant or writer acceptance as a fresh received Grant
Lower5050 reserve or ignore a pending Heartbeat just to obtain a passing session
Reuse an old nonce/cycle/lease or call rearm after one PARAM
Convert low-speed fallback into high-speed success
Clear first-fault, STOP or diagnostic records to conceal a previous failure

needed_test_first_cases: Replay the saved ordering: VPrepared40579/commit40781/HB41029, Ground PARAM1/Held27469, no Release, retained t0; verify current failure before fixing
Safe-cancel exact tuple followed by a real distinct Heartbeat writer: AbortAck succeeds without changing writer lease, pending action, accepted bytes, AUX/tail processing or Heartbeat progress
Bare busy/tail without retirement remains rejected; wrong nonce/boot/epoch/cycle/token/generation, old accepted Grant, high-speed owner or unknown prefix all remain rejected
Late Abort after the Ground501-ms failure can quarantine the exact never-negotiated owner only if original first fault and t0 stay frozen; no forged two-ACK success
Late old Release/Commit and duplicate Abort cannot revive or replay RF; one missing or partial USB AbortAck remains ABORT_UNCONFIRMED with no retry

Prepublication defer retires a real pending Grant, never publishes old Prepared, never consumes the published cancellation budget, never resets preparation time, and accepts only a genuinely later cycle/token/generation
No-HB/known suitable phase can still prepare and release once; repeated unsuitable phases expire at the original8s/15s budgets; all legacy timing boundaries and macro-off paths remain intact
Both registered default reader test and optional actual sealed full-binding test still validate exact compiler flags and metadata, preventing a new missing-field integration gap

pin_and_artifact_impact: Changing firmware/phase6/vc_lora_phase6_bridge.hpp or high_speed/r19_grant_reservation.hpp changes canonical source91, staged package, real application/ELF and source-bound Agreement contract. A new candidate build/independent verification/final seal is required; do not relabel the old90a candidate.

Get-R19GrantAgreementCandidateContract dynamically binds bridge, core reservation header, wire, workflow, contract, capture, builder/common/verifier. A changed workflow/capture/header therefore invalidates old exact contract payloads even if the contract script bytes remain unchanged.

runtime28 includes workflow, capture and outer. Any changed runtime tool requires a new reviewed prepared closure and fresh one-run permit; preserve older prepared files and mark them unusable for changed digests.

Outer owns reviewed static reader/gate/flash/capture digests plus candidate latest selection; timed mode derives these from the exact prepared pin. Synchronize only genuinely changed files after source freeze.

Flash tool separately pins expectedCandidateVerifierSha256, expectedCandidateCommonSha256 and expectedGrantReservationContractSha256. These need new reviewed values only if those tool implementations change; a dynamic contract payload change alone is not a reason to relax or rewrite a static source pin.

Reader/decoder v12/24raw/13symbols and Fatal128/STOP128/base512 ABIs need no change for a pure scheduling/boundary fix unless the implementation intentionally changes a diagnostic ABI; avoid broadening scope. Preserve accepted R18 baseline hashes and all sealed historical evidence.
remaining_uncertainty: The exact active-writer predicate responsible for Vehicle detail20 was not latched separately. Global busy/tail rejection during resumed normal Heartbeat is strongly consistent with code and observed ordering, but remains a saved-evidence hypothesis until reproduced by a real bridge offline fixture or additional explicitly authorized record capture.
